Ebr. 190, fol. 177r, whose tenth grade is 'fundamentum [read secretum] denarii', not a hierarchy; he notes the parallel to Dionysius's nine but does not say Pico chose nine because of Dionysius (claims 001-003). Pal. 885 fol. 145r), and Abulafia's equation of Metatron with the Active Intellect and 'son'. Textual crux at the Oration's Enoch passage: Garin prints asterisks, the princeps a blank, the Opera Omnia a Hebrew phrase Wirszubski thinks may be 'angelus divinitatis'.
